# Uniform prices

- Polo shirt: 8 pounds each.
- Sweatshirt: 14 pounds each. A school badge sewn on costs 3 pounds more per sweatshirt, only when the parent asks for it.
- PE bag: 6 pounds each. Children in Reception get their first PE bag free.

The supplier needs one count per item and size, with badge sweatshirts counted apart from plain ones.
